skills.note: OpenCode's own location. It would also read .claude/skills, but DDW does not make one tool depend on another tool's directory.

commands.body:
Use the `{name}` skill to answer this. Follow it exactly.

$ARGUMENTS
commands.note: OpenCode discovers skills but does not expose them as /name — that is a separate feature reading .opencode/commands/ (plural, per opencode.ai/docs/commands). Without this the installer's own closing line told the user to type /ddw-status and the TUI answered that no such command exists.

agents._when_readonly_note: OpenCode's permission keys are read/edit/bash/… — there is no `write`. `edit: deny` already covers write, edit and apply_patch.

choice_prompt.note: the question tool — header, question, options, and a free answer
